select a.id as id, a.contract_id as contract_id, b.project_distribution_id as project_distribution_id, a.distribution_status as distributionStatus, a.approval_status as approvalStatus, b.contract_code as contractCode, b.proj_name as projName, b.contract_start_date as contractStartDate, c.biz_dept_id as contractBelongDeptId, c.proj_sponsor_user_id as sponsorUserId, b.proj_classify as projClassify, b.proj_source as projSource, d.proj_source as projReviewSource, b.effect_year as effectYear, b.effect_month as effectMonth from kpi_project_distribution as a left join kpi_project_distribution_base_info as b on a.id = b.project_distribution_id left join contract_base_info as c on a.contract_id = c.id left join proj_review_base_info as d on c.proj_review_id = d.id
